# firezone_actor (Resource)

An Actor - a user, admin, or service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "firezone_actor" "ci_deployer" {
  name = "ci-deployer"
  type = "service_account"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Actor name.
- `type` (String) One of account_user, account_admin_user, service_account. api_client also exists but cannot be managed via this API.

### Optional

- `allow_email_otp_sign_in` (Boolean) Whether this Actor may sign in via a one-time passcode emailed to them.
- `email` (String) Email address. Required for account_user and account_admin_user; must be omitted for service_account.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Actor is enabled. Disabling revokes all of its active Client tokens and portal sessions immediately.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Actor ID.
